crossRefs.note: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

translations.web: Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then Jephthah the Gileadite died, and was buried in the cities of Gilead.
translations.bsb: Jephthah judged Israel six years, and when he died, he was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
translations.kjv: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
translations.asv: And Jephthah judged Israel six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
